brand_identity: Premium minimal visual technology brand. Apple-like restraint, architectural editorial design, high-end display technology, GCC engineering credibility.

headings.usage: Use Manrope for all H1-H4 headings. STRICTLY FORBIDDEN: Inter. Ensure tight tracking (tracking-tight) and tight leading (leading-none).

body.usage: Use IBM Plex Sans for body text, descriptions, and lists. Use leading-relaxed for optimal legibility.

labels_overlines.usage: Use for the 'ENGINEERING BRILLIANCE' label and category tags.

layouts_and_grids.spacing_philosophy: Generous spacing. Use 2-3x more spacing than typical templates (p-8, p-12, p-24, py-32). Let the whitespace create a sense of premium luxury and architectural scale.
layouts_and_grids.bento_grid: MODE A (Tetris Grid) for Project & Industry presentations. Use asymmetric spans (e.g., col-span-8 for hero project, col-span-4 for supporting), gap-8 or gap-12.
layouts_and_grids.alignment: Left-align dense text and headings. Avoid centering everything. Tension creates interest.

surfaces.header_and_floating_docks: GLASSMORPHISM (Crystal Variant): backdrop-blur-2xl with bg-black/60 (dark) or bg-white/70 (light), 1px delicate inner stroke border-white/10.
surfaces.cards: Cardless or minimal solid surfaces. No muddy gray transparency. If using cards, 1px subtle border, flat background, no soft shadow.

visual_enhancers.overlays: Hero images MUST have an overlay between bg-black/30 and bg-black/50. If using gradient overlay for text legibility, use bg-gradient-to-r from-black/70 via-black/40 to-transparent. DO NOT obscure the image entirely.

components.navigation: Desktop/mobile shared structure. Sticky fixed header (z-50) using Crystal Glassmorphism. Must include Logo, Links (Products, Industries, Architect Path, Signage, Resources), and Contact CTA.
components.floating_contact_controls: Fixed position (e.g., bottom-right or bottom-center dock). Pill-shaped, Glassmorphism finish. Contains contact CTA and potentially the small animated counter island.
components.buttons: Restrained, sharp or pill-shaped. Dark mode: bg-white text-black hover:bg-neutral-200. Light mode: bg-black text-white hover:bg-neutral-800. No heavy gradients.
components.animated_counter_island: A subtle, engineered micro-interaction island showing a numerical counter (e.g., projects completed, display pixels). Use Framer Motion for value ticker. Font: IBM Plex Sans.

hero.copy: Label: 'ENGINEERING BRILLIANCE'. H1: 1-3 words (e.g., 'Architectural Display Technology'). Subtitle: 1 short sentence.
hero.visuals: Full-bleed background image, dark gradient overlay for text contrast, restrained primary CTA.

projects_presentation.layout: Asymmetric Bento Grid (col-span-full md:col-span-8, col-span-4). Emphasize strong imagery. Minimal UI chrome around images.

paths_and_links.layout: Clean list or tight grid. Hover states should feature a subtle translation (-translate-y-1) and text color shift.

media.image_strategy: High-end, architectural, engineered displays. No generic stock. Clean, strong geometry.

motion_and_interactions.scrolling: Use 'lenis' for smooth, momentum-based scrolling. This is critical for the premium architectural feel.
motion_and_interactions.animations: Intentional subtle motion. Use Framer Motion. Apple-like ease springs (duration: 0.8, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1]). Staggered entrance for lists.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Interactive elements MUST explicitly change color or slightly lift on hover. No jarring scales.

accessibility_and_seo.seo_preservation: CRITICAL: Preserve existing URLs, SEO metadata, canonicals, schema, sitemap, routing. Do NOT modify the core semantic structure (nav > ul > li, article, section) representing Phase 2/3.
accessibility_and_seo.content_meaning: Preserve SEO semantic coverage in supporting/body content. Headings can be visually refined to 1-3 words, but ensure the underlying HTML semantics (H1, H2) maintain keyword context if necessary (e.g., via sr-only text paired with minimal visible text, or strictly adhering to approved concise copy).
accessibility_and_seo.performance: No CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift) or hydration failures. Define explicit aspect-ratios for all imagery. Maintain server-rendered homepage integrity.
accessibility_and_seo.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (kebab-case, role-based).

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a visual and copy refinement strictly for Stage C of the Next.js migration.
DO NOT cut over production or start Stage D.
PRESERVE ALL backend/API behavior, analytics, forms, routing, and product data logic.
IMPLEMENT a 'Premium minimal visual technology brand' aesthetic. Remove all generic, wordy, template-driven, or neon-tech UI elements.
REFINE copy: Prominent headings should be 1-3 words. Hero is concise. Keep 'ENGINEERING BRILLIANCE' as a small label.
APPLY the color palette, typography (Manrope/IBM Plex Sans), and strict Glassmorphism overlays detailed in these guidelines.
ENSURE the animated counter island and fixed contact controls are implemented as floating, sticky elements.
USE standard .js files for React components, avoid .tsx since this project uses .js.
CRITICAL: Validate no CLS shifts by setting image dimensions/aspect ratios.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glass-morphism effects (12-24px blur).
DO NOT use dark colors as gradients. Use solid colors with noise/textures.
DO NOT apply universal transition (e.g., 'transition: all'). Add transitions for specific interactive properties.
DO NOT center align the app container. Disrupts natural reading flow.
NEVER use completely transparent backgrounds for headers or overlays that content scrolls under.
Use 2-3x more spacing (p-8, p-12, py-24) than feels comfortable to achieve a premium look.
Prioritize Shadcn UI for complex components, custom HTML/Tailwind for expressive layouts.
Include 'data-testid' attributes on all interactive elements.
